signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a two-story gray-sided home with a large front lawn; a large tree in the foreground partially obscures the upper right of the house.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is mowed and a mulch ring surrounds the tree, but nothing indicates crew-level work such as a crew, equipment, or manicured beds.

solar_panels.evidence: No panels are visible on the roof sections that can be seen, though the view is partly blocked by trees.

signals.notes: A covered vehicle or car under a cover sits near the driveway at the right, possibly on the neighboring property; the lawn is patchy and dry in sunlit areas.
